BiblicalUsage: Philia is friendship, fondness, and it appears once, in James's sharpest warning. He calls his readers adulterers and adulteresses and says the friendship of the world is enmity with God, so whoever will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe James leaves no middle ground: friendship with the world is not neutrality but enmity, and the heart cannot be friends with both.
